dialog.title: Full Auto Mode
dialog.description: Keeps building every To Do ticket, reviewing everything in Review, and merging each ticket as soon as its review comes back clean — continuously, until you switch it off.
dialog.candidates: {build} to build · {review} to review · {merge} ready to merge

options.parallelReviewsHint: Reviews always run at epic level — the branch is what merges.
options.smartDispatch: Pick the agent by track record
options.smartDispatchHint: Only for roles left empty above: dispatches the named agent with the best 30-day success rate, once it has at least 5 finished runs for that role.
options.secondOpinionHint: Before merge, spends one review slot on a short read-only pass by a provider different from both the builder and reviewer.

warning.budget: {builds} builds + {reviews} reviews exceed this project's {budget} parallel agents budget. The extra work will sit in the queue instead of running — raise Max concurrent agents in Settings if you want it to run in parallel.
warning.unattended: Agents run unattended: they build, review and merge into main without anyone watching. A ticket whose review left open findings is never merged, and a merge conflict is handed to a resolution agent — if that fails too, the ticket is parked and you get a notification.
